title: NOTICE NO.RJ/15/2026 DATED 07.07.2026 ALONGWITH LIST OF 288 LEARNED ADVOCATES WHO ARE HAVING THE HIGH COURT ADVOCATES CODE BUT THEIR SANADS WERE DEPOSITED OR THEY ARE IN SERVICE OR THEIR SANADS ARE TRANSFERRED TO ANOTHER STATE.
text:
KEY LINES:
apply
07/07/2026

FULL TEXT:
NOTICE
No.RJ/45 /2026
As
directed
by
the
Honourable
the
Chief
Justice,
all
concerned
Learned
Advocates
(list
attached herewith
for
ready
reference)
are
hereby
informed
that
the
Advocate
Codes
allotted
to
them
by
the
High
Court
of
Gujarat are
proposed
to
be
deleted
from
the
computer
software
[shall
be
shown
in
brackets
(
)],
pursuant
to
the
information
received
from
the
Bar
Council
of
Gujarat confirming
that
their
Sanads have been
deposited
on
account
of their
being
in
service
or
for
any
other
reason.
Further,
the
Sanads
of
certain
Learned
Advocates have been
transferred
to
other
States,
and
therefore
they
no
longer
hold
an
enrollment
number
with
the
Bar
Council
of
Gujarat.
Accordingly,
the
concerned Learned
Advocates
are
herebyinformed
that,
if
they
have any
objection or
query
regarding the
proposed
deletion
of their
Advocate
Codes, they
may
approach
the
Office
of
the
Registrar
(judicial)
within
15
days from
the date
of
publication
of
this
Notice.
Upon
expiry
of
the
said
period
of
15
days,
the
Advocate
Codes
allotted
to
such
Advocates
shall
stand deleted
from
the
computer
software.
It
is
further
notified that,
in
the
event
any
such Learned
Advocate
has
applied
to
the
Bar
Council
of
Gujarat
for
re-issuance
of
his/her
Sanad, he/she
may, upon
obtaining
the
same,
apply
for
allotment
of a
fresh
Advocate
Code
in
accordance
with
the
prevailing practice
of
the
High Court
of
Gujarat.
By Order
of
the Hon'ble
Chief Justice
